notes: All PNG layers use the exact 894x839 source canvas.
Visible head and ponytail artwork is directly extracted from the original source without resizing or repositioning.
The long ears and front hair locks remain rigidly attached to the head.
The large rear/top ponytail is a spring layer.
Armor, shield, sword, torso and all body equipment remain in the static body layer.
A narrow hidden body/neck region behind the head was reconstructed only to support subtle head movement.
A tiny hidden scalp area under the ponytail root was reconstructed only where spring motion could reveal it.
eyes_closed.png is a full-canvas transparent blink overlay containing only the eye regions.
hair_back, hair_left, hair_right and beard were skipped because they do not add enough independent motion to justify extra seams.
Normalized pivot coordinates use x=0 left, x=1 right, y=0 bottom, y=1 top.
